scope: No-go theorem for a unique operator-valued interaction selected naturally from one simple-spectrum faithful state under all state-preserving inner automorphisms; no set-valued or source-augmented selector theorem is claimed.

gu_typed_objects.carrier: M_n(C) with simple-spectrum faithful rho and its diagonal-phase stabilizer; LAYER=observed; CHIRALITY=N/A
gu_typed_objects.pairing: Hilbert-Schmidt/Gibbs pairing and imported trace/state-effect pairing ON=repository_owned_modular_control
gu_typed_objects.grading: diagonal versus off-diagonal modular spectral sectors; no source BV, BFV or ghost grading

preflight_bookend.route_change: Test uniqueness before generator construction: an input fixed by a symmetry forces any natural unique output to be fixed by that symmetry.
preflight_bookend.retrieval_collision_result: K96-K99 show examples of algebra/graph nonselection. They do not prove that every unique operator assignment from rho alone is diagonal by stabilizer equivariance.

theorem.stabilizer: D=diag(e^(i theta_1),...,e^(i theta_n)) with D rho D^*=rho
theorem.fixed_input_consequence: S(rho)=D S(rho) D^* for every D in the stabilizer
theorem.selected_operator: S(rho) is diagonal and commutes with rho and H
theorem.dynamical_consequence: only zero-Bohr/dephasing structure; no population transition graph
theorem.maximum_no_go: rho and its modular flow cannot uniquely and equivariantly select a nontrivial transition interaction operator

escape_boundaries.distinguished_observable: supplying X with off-diagonal entries selects a graph from X but imports the missing owner
escape_boundaries.explicit_symmetry_breaking: a preferred basis phase, locality net or source action may reduce the stabilizer
escape_boundaries.set_valued_selector: an orbit or spectral subspace can be selected without choosing one operator
escape_boundaries.degenerate_state: has a larger stabilizer and needs a separately typed theorem

postflight_bookend.strongest_overclaim: Extending the no-go to set-valued selectors or selectors supplied with locality, symmetry-breaking or source-action data.
postflight_bookend.strongest_contrary_construction: A distinguished off-diagonal observable X breaks the stabilizer and selects its own transition support.
postflight_bookend.weakest_reproducibility_seam: The theorem assumes naturality under the full state stabilizer; a weaker covariance category may permit extra outputs and must name that extra structure.

claim_ceiling: Exact no-go for unique full-stabilizer-equivariant operator selection from one simple faithful state only; no set-valued, source-augmented, locality-breaking, Born, prediction, confirmation, held-out score, promotion or verdict.
